candidates.why_maybe_new: Expansion of the Texas Eastern system with no row of its own. 10.2 mi 36-in loop plus 1.6 mi 16-in lateral (about 19 km), 125,000 Dth/d, FERC CP26-75, in service Sept 2028. Data center tie is indirect: it feeds the plant Entergy is building with the Amazon deal, adjacent to the AWS campus. Medium confidence.

Medium tie: no source names a data center as the pipeline's own customer.
